header: The frame around a contact form, not the form
subheader: Heading, response time, what to write, and the button that opens it.
lead: Form handling belongs to the TYPO3 form framework: this element renders the band and never the fields, the validation or the submission.
bodytext:
Rich text carries what a visitor should have to hand before they start writing, which is the part of a contact page that actually shortens the exchange.

The second action is a ghost button rather than a link, because a phone number is a real alternative rather than a footnote to the form.
note: Only promise a response time somebody can hold: the band is the visible half of a promise the form framework has to keep.
